Name: Farm Screenshot Planner
Author: kaixindawanglpc
Description:
[heading]About[/heading]
[list]
[*]I just wanted to plan my farm layout properly, but the game's built-in screenshot feature doesn't have grid lines, making it hard to align things against the pixel art. So I made this mod — the concept is simple: it calls the game's built-in screenshot function and overlays a customizable grid, making farm planning intuitive.[/*]
[/list][heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Full map screenshots: Capture the complete panoramic view of your current location (farm, greenhouse, Ginger Island, quarry, etc.)[/*]
[*]Customizable grid: Supports color, thickness (1-3px), and opacity[/*]
[*]Output scaling: 25%/50%/75%/100% presets[/*]
[*]GMCM integration: Built-in Generic Mod Config Menu support (optional dependency)[/*]
[*]Location selection: Choose specific locations to screenshot via GMCM dropdown menu (sorted by name)[/*]
[*]Thumbnail preview: Displays a thumbnail in the result menu after screenshot is complete[/*]
[*]Skip hotkey: Press X during screenshot processing to skip waiting and immediately regain control[/*]
[*]Flexible save paths: Option to save to the game's default screenshot directory[/*]
[*]Instant access: Result dialog pops up after screenshot with one-click "Open Folder"[/*]
[*]Auto cleanup: Option to delete the game's original screenshot file after processing[/*]
[*]i18n: Supports English and Simplified Chinese[/*]
[*]Console command: Use /farm_screenshot [location_name][/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Extract to Stardew Valley/Mods/FarmScreenshotPlanner[/*]
[*]Launch the game[/*]
[/list][heading]Default Hotkeys[/heading]
[list]
[*]J - Capture full map of current location[/*]
[*]X - Skip waiting, immediately regain game control[/*]
[/list][heading]Configuration File[/heading]
Generates config.json after first run, with the following options:
[list]
[*]Hotkey: Screenshot hotkey (default: J)[/*]
[*]CancelHotkey: Skip waiting hotkey (default: X)[/*]
[*]SelectedLocation: Screenshot location (default: "Current Location")[/*]
[*]OutputScale: Scale ratio (0.25, selectable 25%/50%/75%/100% in GMCM)[/*]
[*]SavePath: Screenshot save path (default: Screenshots/)[/*]
[*]UseGameScreenshotFolder: Save to game's default screenshot directory (default: false)[/*]
[*]DeleteGameOriginal: Delete game's original screenshot after processing (default: true)[/*]
[*]Grid.Enabled: Enable grid (default: true)[/*]
[*]Grid.Color: Grid color RRGGBBAA (default: 00000060)[/*]
[*]Grid.Thickness: Grid thickness 1-3 (default: 1)[/*]
[*]Grid.Opacity: Grid opacity 0-1 (default: 0.5)[/*]
[/list][heading]Changelog[/heading]
[list]
[*]1.0.0 - Initial release[/*]
[*]1.1.0 - Added skip waiting hotkey, fixed scroll wheel zoom, fixed menu misalignment on window switch, adjusted default configuration[/*]
[/list][heading]Source Code[/heading]
[list]
[*]This mod is open source on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/O-o123-code/FarmScreenshotPlanner.git]https://github.com/O-o123-code/FarmScreenshotPlanner.git[/url][/*]
[/list][heading]Credits[/heading]

[/list]
